knowledge_memory_scope: Separate datasets/banks for RAGFlow and separate OpenViking native workspace/account for formal cases

native_memory_types.openviking: release defaults, self memory, working memory off

retrieval: Native KB and native Memory search; at most 6 ranked unique hits from each. Use native returned full content. RAGFlow derived memory can follow its explicit source_id through the native content API. No oracle-dependent hydration or archive scan at answer time. Full source-preservation audit is separate.
source_fidelity_checks: Native original download and native archived user message read; compare original UTF-8 bytes after updates and restart
performance_limitations: One provider request at a time in the shared budget gateway
Cold account initialization and model latency must be reported separately from stable query time

timestamp_transport.change: Map the frozen record timestamp into OpenViking AddMessageRequest.created_at before any formal OpenViking ingestion. The date remains in identical user_input text for both products. RAGFlow AddMessageRequest has no event-time input field; its native extractor sets derived valid_at from that text.
timestamp_transport.reason: Calibration archived the imported historical conversation at the current import time; the supported API can preserve its supplied original message timestamp.

cost_and_timing_boundary: Both answer phases use ready native indexes and the same serial provider gateway. OpenViking formal ingestion starts in a new native workspace/account; RAGFlow formal ingestion starts in new datasets/banks on its already initialized trial service. Thus total setup/ingestion wall time and bootstrap cost are observations, not a matched cold-start performance comparison. The formal provider totals retain all actual costs. Steady query times are one small sequential sample, not a throughput result.

runtime_recovery_boundary.original_amd64_restart: Did not meet readiness; the entrypoint timed out under high host load.
runtime_recovery_boundary.continuation: Preserve a complete workspace snapshot, then use the official ARM64 build of the same 0.5.0 release with the existing data and vectors. No source reingestion, memory re-extraction, or repeated scored answer.
runtime_recovery_boundary.remaining_quality_condition: Same cases, 4096-dimensional model, Luna model profile, context budget, retrieval limits, and shared reader. Execution platform differs after recovery.
